questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first and the last sentences (S1 and S6) are in the correct order, the sentences in between are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

S1: The history of boats is older than the history and the earliest evidence of writing in any civilisation.

A. It was a three-feet long dugout, meaning it was made from a hollowed bark of the Pinus Sylvestris tree.

B. Archaeological data states that the oldest boat built by them dates back to 8200-7600 BC.

C. The earliest boats were not built by modern humans but by their predecessors, the Homo Erectus.

D. It is called the Pesse canoe and was discovered in the Netherlands.

S6: However, experts believe that boats were very much in use before that as well.
questions.solution: The correct order of sentences is S1-CBDA-S6. S1 begins the paragraph by telling us that the history of boats is older than the history and also from the earliest evidence of writing in any civilisation. C follows S1 to tell us that the earliest boats were developed by the predecessors of modern humans, the Homo Erectus. B follows C to tell us that they created the first ever boat around 8200-7600 BC. D follows B to tell us that the boat was named the Pesse canoe and was found in the Netherlands.
